plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that two scientists, Kit Green, whom he links to the CIA, and Garry Nolan, have been looking at the biological effects on people who say they witnessed or encountered UFOs. He mentions damage from electromagnetic radiation as one such effect, and calls it CIA spooky stuff. If true, it would mean these encounters leave physical marks on the body that can be studied.
